title: Compress one inverse scalar bound into a small weighted-ball witness
statement: One inverse force has exact history family X=intersection_i Ball(x_i+c*(p-p_i),b*||p-p_i||). body: For centers c_i and squared radii r_i^2, define cbar=sum w_i*c_i and R^2=sum w_i*r_i^2-sum w_i*||c_i-cbar||^2. Weighted squared-ball inequalities imply ||z-cbar||^2<=R^2, hence v*z<=v*cbar+||v||R. Under Slater, KKT plus conical Caratheodory reduces an optimal endpoint normal to at most d active balls, attaining the bound. Degenerate intersections require limits; no exact at-most-d attainment is asserted there. Numerical optimization only proposes weights. Acquired focused certificates at four directions/eight endpoints were independently recomputed from recorded pairs with exact arithmetic and40-bit outward root enclosures. Source spatial gains and whole-suite replay are not independently replayed. The103-bit figure applies only to six spatial selected certificates; focused certificates reach326 bits and the native iteration final radius denominator has582 bits. Proof support size, numerical precision, arithmetic cost and CPU complexity differ.
